code.jomission/qualification/cmin.py: 83aef5c33e3cffd6e6fda28b2135254f7c506b09 (build_cmin: source of the PV cell parameters)

frozen.cell: all PV cells of build_cmin(): a, b, c, d read from model.params['emitter'] (observed homogeneous: a 0.1, b 0.2, c -65, d 2; 40 cells)
frozen.isolation: simulate_population with rec = {} (no recurrent input) and a zero schedule; tonic I0 = I is the only coordinate
frozen.native_noise: 0.5*N(0,1) per cell per step, numpy PCG64 seed 32100 (common to every I; the engine JAX stream is not reproducible outside the model)
frozen.time: dt 0.1 ms; 4 x 5 s chunks (50000 steps); analysis windows 1-3

estimator: r(I) = mean over analysis windows 1-3 of the class-mean rate (spikes / (40 cells * 5 s)), the gate rate_hz estimator

procedure.2_bracket: bisection only if r(2.8) < 10 <= r(3.6); otherwise classify PV_CALIBRATION_FAIL and evaluate nothing further
procedure.3_bisection: on r(I) - 10 inside [2.8, 3.6] until bracket width <= 0.0125; I_PV10 = linear interpolation of 10 Hz between the final bracket rates
procedure.4_slope: evaluate r at I_PV10 +- 0.05 and +- 0.1, each clipped to [2.8, 3.6]; g_05 and g_10 are the corresponding difference quotients; g_PV = g_05

classification.PV_CALIBRATION_PASS: finite I_PV10 in [2.8, 3.6] and usable slope
classification.PV_CALIBRATION_UNRESOLVED: bracketed, but the estimator or onset prevents reliable inversion: a bisection evaluation contradicts monotonicity with an earlier evaluation by more than 1 Hz, or the final bracket rates differ by more than 5 Hz (onset discontinuity), or the slope is unusable

reported_not_gating.diagnostic_reading: isolated r(2.8) vs network V_MID PV 0.0 Hz: r(2.8) >= 5 Hz reads as network-mediated PV suppression at V_MID; r(2.8) < 1 Hz reads as the battery_b1 F-I inversion failing near threshold
reported_not_gating.network_comparison: isolated r(3.6) vs network V_HIGH PV 20.0-20.2 Hz (results/v21_high.json)
reported_not_gating.analytic_reference: deterministic saddle-node of the Izhikevich rest point for the frozen PV parameters: 0.04 v^2 + (5 - b) v + 140 + I = 0 loses its real roots at I = (5 - b)^2 / 0.16 - 140 = 4.0 (DERIVED, not gating)
